source: RFC 7519 §1, §7.2 step 1; RFC 9068 §4; ADR 0027 §6; ADR 0049 §2; conformance/tools/jwt-oracle (node:crypto, Node v24.21.0, OpenSSL 3.5.8)
description: A valid HS256 JWT with every RFC 9068 §2.2 claim but no protected typ, rewrapped as flattened JSON with the attacker unprotected header {"typ":"at+jwt"} to pass as an access token; signature unchanged and valid. A JWT is compact only (ADR 0027 §6), and typing is never read from an unprotected header (ADR 0049 §2): InvalidFormat under profile access_token
